name: Votary
description:
Agents of Higher Wills

Votaries wield borrowed power. Through pacts—formal or otherwise—they bind themselves to supernatural beings whose motives are vast, alien, or divine. In exchange for service, devotion, or obedience, a Votary is granted magic that reflects their patron’s nature and agenda.

Their spells carry authority rather than technique, invoking judgment, protection, or annihilation by proxy. Whether calling down blessings, commanding spirits, or reshaping life and death, Votaries act as instruments of an external will imposed upon the mortal world.

A Votary’s power is never truly their own—
but neither are its consequences.

Domains of Magic

Votaries command magic rooted in cosmic authority:

  • Life and death: healing, resurrection, undeath

  • Divine judgment and protection

  • Planar interaction: celestials, fey, binding, banishment

  • Sacred warfare: smites, auras, sanctified ground

  • Ritual authority backed by a patron’s mandate

Taboo: Disobedience

For Votaries, betrayal is worse than death. Even questioning a patron’s will can be spiritually perilous.

Power demands loyalty.

Fault Lines

  • Arcanists deny divine primacy.

  • Wildhearts reject cosmic mandates.

  • Witches demand accountability after miracles.
